description_en: Queries the forgot password policy for a specified EIAM instance
description_zh: 查询指定EIAM实例下忘记密码策略
name: GetForgetPasswordConfiguration

AuthenticationChannels.description_en:
The list of forgot password authentication channels. Required when ForgetPasswordStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:

email: Email.
sms: SMS.
totp: OTP dynamic password.
web_authn: WebAuthn
AuthenticationChannels.description_zh: 忘记密码认证渠道列表。当forgetPasswordStatus取值为enabled时必传。枚举取值:email(邮件)、sms(短信)、totp(OTP动态口令)、web_authn(WebAuthn)

Enable.description_en: [Deprecated] Indicates whether the forgot password feature is enabled. This parameter is deprecated. Use the ForgetPasswordStatus parameter instead

ForgetPasswordStatus.description_en:
The forgot password configuration status. Valid values:

enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
